name: Plitvice Lakes
tagline: Sixteen turquoise lakes linked by waterfalls
summary: Plitvice Lakes is Croatia's oldest national park: 16 terraced lakes in shades of turquoise, joined by waterfalls and crossed by wooden boardwalks through the forest. It's one of Europe's most beautiful natural sights.
seasonNote: Spring has the most water; autumn the best colours. Summer is crowded and tickets cost more. Winter brings frozen falls.
arrival: Buses from Zagreb take about 2.5 hours and from Split about 4. Stay nearby to arrive at opening.
gettingAround: Park boats and electric trains link the trails; included in the ticket.
cashTip: Cards are widely accepted; carry euro cash for ferries, markets and small konobas.
foodTip: Grilled trout, spit-roast lamb and Lika potatoes.
